helpers.cm_gcd:
function cm_gcd(a, b)
  a = math.abs(a)
  b = math.abs(b)
  while b ~= 0 do
    a, b = b, a % b
  end
  return a
end
helpers.cm_get:
function cm_get(xs, i)
  if i < 0 or i >= #xs then error('index out of range') end
  return xs[i + 1]
end
helpers.cm_ipow:
function cm_ipow(a, b)
  local r = 1
  while b > 0 do
    if b % 2 == 1 then r = r * a end
    b = b // 2
    if b > 0 then a = a * a end
  end
  return r
end
helpers.cm_max_f: function cm_max_f(a, b) if b > a then return b else return a end end
helpers.cm_max_i: function cm_max_i(a, b) if b > a then return b else return a end end

helpers.cm_min_i: function cm_min_i(a, b) if b < a then return b else return a end end
helpers.cm_powmod:
function cm_powmod(a, b, m)
  local r = 1 % m
  a = a % m
  while b > 0 do
    if b % 2 == 1 then r = (r * a) % m end
    a = (a * a) % m
    b = b // 2
  end
  return r
end
helpers.cm_print_list:
function cm_print_list(xs, tag)
  print('l:' .. #xs)
  for i = 1, #xs do
    if tag == 'f' then print('f:' .. string.format('%.17g', xs[i])) else print('i:' .. string.format('%d', xs[i])) end
  end
end
helpers.cm_set:
function cm_set(xs, i, v)
  if i < 0 or i >= #xs then error('index out of range') end
  xs[i + 1] = v
end
